title: gusto out/manifest.sig, version 1
description: A detached Ed25519 signature over the exact bytes of out/manifest.json. The public key it carries shows whether the manifest changed after signing; who the key belongs to is the verifier's keyring's word, never this file's. A record without this file is unsigned. A reader ignores a field it does not know.

version.description: The format of this file. A file without it is version 1. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

scheme.description: The signature scheme. ed25519 signs the manifest's bytes as written. ed25519-sha512 signs their SHA-512 digest with plain Ed25519, for a key a key service holds and limits the size of what it signs.

key.description: The id of the key that signed: "sha256:" and the first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key, as lowercase hex. A keyring finds the signer's name by it.

publicKey.description: The raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, in standard base64. Its id must be `key`.

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature over out/manifest.json, in standard base64.
